about_the_game:
Recreate the vast history of the Spring and Autumn Period and the Warring States Period

You will be in the ever-changing situation of the Spring and Autumn Period and the Warring States Period, and personally experience the complex world full of intrigues, wars and alliances. Fight side by side with historical generals and participate in the struggle between hundreds of vassal states. Every decision you make will affect the future of this land. Here, you can choose to be the ruler of a powerful empire and hold great power, or an ordinary nobleman, relying on wisdom and courage to fight for a place in the chaos. From the rise and fall of the family to the vertical and horizontal of the countries, every dispute is full of power and life and death behind it. Manage the family and develop the country, you will become a part of history. This is a war of blood and fire, and also a contest of courage and wisdom.

Huge and detailed strategic map

The strategic map at the core of the game truly restores the geographical features of the Eastern Zhou Dynasty. From the great rivers to the continuous mountains, from the prosperous cities to the remote borders, you will strategize and confront on this vast land. Hundreds of cities and no data points constitute this battlefield full of opportunities and challenges. The ups and downs of mountains and rivers, the direction of rivers, and the smoothness of roads will all become important factors in strategic decision-making. Famous passes such as Mount Xiao and Hangu are places of contention for military strategists, and dynamic seasonal changes will also directly affect military operations. By controlling the terrain and allocating resources, you will control the key to determining the outcome of the war.

A variety of choices and variables

Is it to maintain the feudal system to gain the support of the nobles, or to implement the county system to strengthen centralization? Is it to follow the Zhou Li to maintain tradition, or to reform the country to enrich the country and strengthen the army? In this vast world, your choice is never simple. In addition to dealing with threats from other countries, you must always be vigilant against political turmoil and maintain the power and status of your family. Whether it is through direct military conquest of territory or through delicate diplomatic alliances, the complex situation of the Spring and Autumn Period and the Warring States Period makes every choice full of risks and opportunities. The struggle of family heirs, the bribery and conspiracy of powerful officials, and even the betrayal and alliance between ordinary nobles will change the pattern of the entire world and make the course of history full of variables.

Write your own chapter

This is not only a reappearance of history, but also a comprehensive challenge of strategy and decision-making. The ever-changing situation of the Spring and Autumn Period and the Warring States Period is waiting for you to write your own chapter. In this world full of opportunities and challenges, you will no longer be a bystander, but the real master of this era. Every decision will affect the future of the countries, and every victory will rewrite the history of the Eastern Zhou Dynasty. Your Majesty, let the princes of the countries tremble at your feet. Sweep the world, shock the world, and create an immortal grand hegemony!

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: Intel® Core™ i3-2120 / AMD® FX 6350
  • Memory: 6 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Nvidia® GeForce™ GTX 660 (2GB) / AMD® Radeon™ HD 7870 (2GB) / Intel® Iris Pro™ 580 / Intel® Iris® Plus G7 / AMD® Radeon™ Vega 11
  • Storage: 8 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 11
  • Processor: Intel® Core™ i5-4670K / AMD® Ryzen™ 5 2400G
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Nvidia® GeForce™ GTX 1650 (4GB) / AMD® Radeon™ R9 390X (8GB)
  • Storage: 8 GB available space

short_description: This is a grand strategy game set in the Spring and Autumn period and the Warring States Period. Become an empire ruler or an ambitious noble, shaping your dynasty through politics and war. Face family conspiracies and minister betrayals, and write an immortal legend with your brilliant strategies.

Simplified Chinese*, Traditional Chinese*
*languages with full audio support
